main_text.p: 25:39. Zach. 1: 9. 13. 14. Exspectabat itaque se Deum coram habiturủ secum colloquentem. Præsupponit propheta priorem visionem fuisse abruptam, in quâ viderat Deum judicem, accusatos justorum oppressores ex tribunali alloquentem: atque eundem audiverat eos corripientem, sententiamque contra eos pronunciantem: at hactenus nihil post eam dixerat Propheta; qui proinde jam cupit experiri, an non eâdem visione, & aliquo ulteriori alloquio dignarētur.

§. 3. Huic adjungit spem ulteriorem, quid referre detur ad elenchum suum. Sermonem suum anteriorem, per modum instantiæ prolatum, vocat תוכחה, quod ex fœdere instituram ἐπερώτησιν seu restipulationem notat. Ita significat Job. 23:4. 7. ut sit demonstratio juris ex lege aut fœdere, cum convictione alterius: hæc dum stipulationem allegat ut præstitam, infert promissi debitorem factum qui promiserat. Hujus elenchi facultatem concedit cuilibet fœderato Deus Jef. 1:28. ut liceat eum convenire, & cum fiduciâ de rebus, in fœdere promissis, compellare.
main_text.head: Verf. 2.

p.i: Et respondit Jehovah mihi, & dixit: scribe visionem, & explana eam super tabulas, ut eam legens percurrat.

main_text.p: §. 1. Non frustra se, incitante spiritu sancto, composuit propheta ad excipiendum ulterius Dei responsum; unde etiam quid secutum fuerit hunc apparatum innuit, scribens, & respondit mihi Jehovah. Hæc est divina erga populum suum clementia, quod nolit temporibus explorationis pios suis destitutos consolationibus: unde illis aperit consilium suum, atque ita respondet eo-rum

page.notes: Left margin notes: "25:39." and "Zach. 1: 9. 13. 14." are printed in the left margin beside the first paragraph; they are transcribed inside the paragraph at their position. The small mark above "habituru" in the first paragraph is a printing or scan artefact and was left as is. The Hebrew word "תוכחה" is printed in the text at §. 3 and is in Hebrew letters as printed. The "§. 3." and "§. 1." paragraph openers are printed in ordinary type and kept as paragraphs. The line "Verf. 2." is a verse reference set apart and is marked as a level 3 heading. The catchword "rum" and signature "Rr 3" are at the foot. Two very faint printing errors or uncertain letters: "habituru" (possibly "habiturum" with a worn m) and "restipulationem" are as read from the scan.
